subject: general
question:
In the given sentence, one of the four underlined words is incorrectly spelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

She __dabbled__ in __drawing__ and painting, but __scalpture__ was her __favourite__ medium.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"scalpture"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be spelled as **"sculpture"**.

 
 
• **English Meaning:** A three-dimensional work of art made by carving stone, wood, or other materials, or by casting metal or other materials. (मूर्ति)
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** मूर्ति या शिल्प
 
• **Example:** The museum has an ancient sculpture carved from marble.
 
 
 
• The correct spelling is **"sculpture"**.
 
 
• **English Meaning:** Same as above – a three-dimensional artistic creation. (मूर्ति)
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** मूर्ति
 
• **Example:** She specializes in creating modern sculptures using recycled materials.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Drawing** (चित्र बनाना): The act of making marks on a surface to create an image or design.

 
 
• **Example:** She enjoys drawing landscapes in her free time.
 
 
 
• **Favourite** (पसंदीदा): A person or thing that is preferred or liked more than others.
 
 
• **Example:** Chocolate ice cream is her favourite dessert.
 
 
 
• **Dabbled** (हाथ आजमाना): To take part in an activity in a casual or superficial way.
 
 
• **Example:** He dabbled in photography before pursuing painting full-time.
